name: Timber_Plaster_Wall
description: One modular wall bay, weathered dark wood rectangular frame, warm cream earth-plaster infill, broad exposed sill and header beams. Straight square cut sides suitable for connecting adjacent bays. Freestanding isolated wall only.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE isolated individual model reference for an EXTREMELY STYLIZED HAND-PAINTED old Japanese fantasy village game.
The village map reference provides subject and period context only; its realistic-looking material rendering must NOT be copied. If a second reference is present, that isolated painted shrine defines the REQUIRED exaggerated shape language, brushwork and palette.

ART DIRECTION IS CRITICAL: much more cartoon-like, simplified and painterly than a detailed miniature or realistic 3D render. Chunky low-poly forms with deliberately exaggerated proportions, big soft bevels, charming slightly wonky silhouettes, oversized structural pieces, thick beams, bold roof curves, very large simplified tiles. Handmade fantasy strategy-game asset art with visibly painted diffuse textures. Broad confident gouache brushstrokes and color planes, painted edge highlights, deep cool violet-blue painted shadows, warm ochre lit faces, a few expressive graphic wood-grain strokes. Reduce modeled and painted microdetail by at least 80 percent: no fine grain, pores, scratches, photoreal moss, individual straw filaments, realistic weathering or dense tiny tilework. Tile roofs read as a small number of big blue/teal shapes; thatch as broad ochre clumps; stone as a few chunky purple-grey shapes; plants as graphic clustered masses. Slight material color gradients should be visibly painted. Matte, diffuse, illustrative, almost storybook concept art, with clear plausible 3D structure a modeler can reproduce. NOT photorealistic, NOT realistic PBR, NOT a high-detail resin diorama, NOT shiny plastic, NOT gritty.

COMPOSITION: one centered full asset, single clean three-quarter near-orthographic view, mildly elevated so front/side/top are readable. Square canvas. Plain warm ivory background with a very subtle flat painted contact shadow. Generous margin around the complete object. No text, labels, measurements, multiple views, montage, environment, scenery, grass pedestal or extra detached items. For flat ground pieces use a higher view. No outlines so heavy that they hide shapes.
PALETTE: cheerful but controlled faded coral-red, terracotta and honey-brown timber, cream plaster, indigo/teal roofs, lavender-grey stone, moss-green accents, jade and olive foliage. Strong large color grouping and excellent readability from a distant gameplay camera.
PERIOD: rustic preindustrial Japanese-inspired shrine village. No modern devices, technology, pipes, asphalt, glowing energy or futuristic ornament.

SUBJECT: One modular wall bay, weathered dark wood rectangular frame, warm cream earth-plaster infill, broad exposed sill and header beams. Straight square cut sides suitable for connecting adjacent bays. Freestanding isolated wall only.
Simplify the subject heavily into an appealing bold hand-painted cartoon game model. Attached details are part of the one asset. Approximate modeling scale, NOT visible text: 2 x 0.2 x 2.5 m.
Use: Optional modular building walls.
STRICT SUBJECT CORRECTION: This is ONLY a flat rectangular timber-framed plaster wall panel for a HOUSE INTERIOR/EXTERIOR MODULE. Absolutely NO roof, NO tiles, NO eaves, NO stone foundation. Exactly one rectangular wall bay: four thick brown timber frame beams enclosing one cream plaster panel. Straight horizontal top beam. Keep design extremely simple.

name: Roofed_Plaster_Wall
description: One repeatable old Japanese boundary wall segment with cream aged earthen plaster between dark timber posts on a rough low stone base, narrow charcoal-blue ceramic tile cap roof. Rectangular straight modular edges, no gateways or decorations.
